arenaRadius.description: Radius of the generated survival map and initial safe zone; layout scales with this value.

spawnRadius.description: Central starting ring radius. Keep enough space for all 32 player bodies.

maxHp.description: Starting health. Bandages restore living players only.

moveSpeed.description: Movement speed; diagonal input is normalized.

gravity.description: Downward acceleration, shared by character movement and portable mods.

attackReach.description: Forward reach of an unarmed strike.

weaponReach.description: Forward reach after collecting a weapon.

attackCooldownMs.description: Time between attacks while the attack button is held.

attackDurationMs.description: Melee swing duration. Windup0–25%, checked contact25–65%, recovery65–100%.

supplyCount.description: Central weapon count, rounded down and capped below participant count.

cacheCount.description: Chest sites inside buildings and along wilderness routes. Blocked sites relocate nearby or are omitted.

supplyRadius.description: Radius of the central weapon ring.

pickupRadius.description: Maximum range for opening and looting an aimed chest with clear line of sight.

zoneDelayMs.description: Exploration grace period before the safe zone starts shrinking.

zoneShrinkMs.description: Time to close the safe zone after the grace period. Keep total closure below the five-minute match limit.

zoneDamagePerSecond.description: Damage per second outside the safe zone; the closed zone hurts everywhere.

bandageDurationMs.description: Stationary uninterrupted hold time to use one bandage.

armorReduction.description: Damage fraction prevented by each equipped armor slot.

bandageHeal.description: Health restored by one completed bandage channel.

bowCooldownMs.description: Recovery delay after releasing an arrow; a new press is required to draw again.

terrainSeed.description: Procedural terrain, building and wilderness chest seed.

bowDrawDurationMs.description: Time to draw the bow fully while holding attack.

bowMinDrawMs.description: Minimum draw time before release can fire an arrow. Short taps cancel without using ammo.

bowReleaseMs.description: Visible release and recovery after a fired arrow.

relations.message: The starting ring needs at least 10% space before the arena edge.
Starts must be at least twice as far from the center as the supplies.
Player height must be at least twice the body radius.
Attack duration cannot exceed its cooldown.
A weapon must deal at least as much damage as an unarmed attack.
A weapon must reach at least as far as an unarmed attack.
Full draw time must be at least the minimum firing draw time.
Bow cooldown must cover the release recovery.
